_comment: External dependency: the @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent release the TypeScript runtime is tested against. Unlike rust-pi-version.json this pins NOTHING at runtime — the SDK backend loads whatever the user has installed globally (see src/sdk-service.ts), and the devcontainer takes @latest. Its only job is to give scripts/check-currency.mjs something to compare npm's latest against, because on a CI runner no global install exists and drift here was therefore invisible. Bump `testedAgainst` when you have actually run the TypeScript side against that version. 1.3.0 was live-verified headlessly (init, a text turn, a turn with one tool call and thinking deltas, one manual compaction, persist, replay, export; every event type handled); resume with restored tools and an extension's boundary-draft entries were not live-run.
